title: Ecosystem Heatmap: Model Provenance, Adoption Storylines, and Trigger Library
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operational heatmap that traces model provenance, adoption storylines across customer segments, and a decision-trigger library for sourcing or switching models. Deliverables: (1) a ranked heatmap CSV (by latency, cost, compatibility, license risk, regional availability), (2) 8 adoption narratives for representative buyer personas, (3) a Trigger Library mapping signals (latency spike, price change, model deprecation) to recommended playbooks (fallback model, reserve capacity, customer comms). Purpose: enable GTM and Platform PMs to make faster sourcing and procurement calls and to automate alert-to-action mappings in the signal hub.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap CSV published with at least 40 distinct model entries and normalized metrics for latency, token-cost, license risk, and regional availability.
Eight concise adoption storylines (1–2 paragraphs each) mapped to buyer personas (SMB search, FinServ RAG, Enterprise chat, Edge analytics).
Trigger Library contains at least 12 signals with actionable playbooks and owner assignments.
Confluence spec with data provenance, scoring rubric, and sample queries is available and linked from the ticket.
Stakeholder review completed with Product, Solutions, and Runtime engineering and feedback items triaged.
A simple dashboard tile in Grafana (or Looker) visualizing top-10 model movement and a scheduled weekly export is configured.
notes: 2025-11-07: Kickoff — aligned on scope with Solutions, Runtime, and Growth. Primary goal is operationalization (not academic benchmarking).
Data sources identified: internal usage logs (s3://redwood-prod/usage/), public model registries, partner procurement feeds (vendor spreadsheets).
Scoring rubric draft: latency (p50/p95 normalized), cost per million tokens, quantization support (yes/no), license friction (none/restricted), regional node coverage (NA/EU/APAC).

Artifact links: Confluence spec https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PM/Ecosystem+Heatmap; Draft CSV in Drive https://drive.google.com/heatmap-draft; Signal hub proto PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/signal-hub/pull/187
Dashboard: created Grafana panel prototype at https://grafana.redwood.com/d/heatmap; scheduled weekly export via infra job infra-job-heatmap-01.
